plan.goal: Log in to Swag Labs, add the Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart, and complete checkout using the buyer's information.

steps.note: Username field on the Swag Labs login page.
Password field on the login page. Masked characters are not legible in the recording; the on-screen text states the password for all users is secret_sauce and login succeeded, so that value is used.
Green Login button below the Username and Password fields.
The Add to cart button on the Sauce Labs Backpack product card ($29.99) on the Products page. Several identical Add to cart buttons are shown, one per product.
Shopping cart icon in the top right of the page; named by its stable label Cart, its badge changes after an item is added.
Checkout button on the Your Cart page.
First Name field on the Checkout: Your Information page.
Last Name field on the Checkout: Your Information page.
Zip/Postal Code field on the Checkout: Your Information page. The exact digits are ambiguous at the resolution of the recording; 20271 is the best reading shown.
Continue button at the bottom right of the Checkout: Your Information page, proceeding to Checkout: Overview.
Finish button at the bottom right of the Checkout: Overview page.
Confirmation message shown on the Checkout: Complete page after finishing.

plan.expected_effect: The Checkout: Complete page is shown with the message 'Thank you for your order!' and a note that the order has been dispatched, after the Sauce Labs Backpack is purchased.
